title: eragrostis subtriflora
intro: Eragrostis subtriflora, commonly known as Devil's Grass or False Signal Grass, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal activities. The therapeutic actions of Eragrostis subtriflora are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. However, the bioactive constituents of this plant are not well-documented, and further research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential uses.
